name: Penguin
summary: A white belly, a dark back, and a sky full of stars.
text:
The back is deep blue, scattered with points of light like a night sky, over a pale belly. It stands on yellow feet.

Most of the light comes through the dark back — this is the piece that looks most like a sky.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
